_README: Hand-reviewed exceptions to the artists catalogue's mechanical rule
(D265, scripts/catalog-curate-lib.mjs). NOT seeded to Firestore and
not a question bank — it is build input for `node
scripts/build-catalog.mjs artists`, listed in check-content.mjs's
NOT_SEEDED with that reason.
WHY A HAND FILE EXISTS HERE AT ALL. The generator ranks by Wikipedia
sitelinks and keeps anyone at least a third of whose Wikidata
occupations are musical. That is the best mechanical rule measured,
and it does not finish: Wikidata's P106 records what a person DID,
never what they are KNOWN FOR, and the list grows with fame. So the
rule still drops Richard Wagner (3 of 11 occupations) and Frank
Sinatra (2 of 10), and every threshold low enough to catch them also
re-admits Charlie Chaplin (3 of 15, he scored his own films) and
Marilyn Monroe (2 of 8, she recorded). No constant separates them.
Roughly eight names in the top 150 need a human; this is where a
human puts them.
HOW TO FILL IT. Run `node scripts/build-catalog.mjs artists
--review-list 300` for the ranked candidates with the fraction that
decided each one, then rule on the ones that are wrong:
reject — in the catalogue, should not be. Needs `why`, because a
rejection nobody can audit is one nobody can reverse.
admit  — a real music artist the ratio dropped. Needs no reason;
the name is the reason.
WHY THIS IS NOT 'entries from model memory' (QUESTION-FARM.md's
domain-day rule). That rule exists because a wrong key silently
resolves someone's stored favourite to the wrong entity, forever.
Every qid here has to be one the generator itself produced —
applyReview() can only drop a row or restore one from the candidate
pool, never mint a key — so neither side can mis-resolve. A reject
can only omit somebody, which the design already permits ('curated,
not complete', plus the 'Not listed' bucket). The builder fails loudly
on an entry whose subject has left the pool, and check:catalogs holds
both sides against the committed catalogue.
Keys are Wikidata QID numeric parts: 1511 means Q1511. Ships EMPTY —
the curation call is the owner's, and D265 recorded it as owed rather
than guessed.
